Job Purpose :
To manage and optimize the performance of sales promotors across channels by ensuring effective deployment, capability development, performance tracking, and productivity monitoring to drive sales growth, product visibility, and customer advocacy

1. Determining the optimal headcount of promotors for each region and retail outlet based on foot traffic and sales potential.
2. Monitoring daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets for the promotor force, identifying underperformers for coaching or reallocation.

4. Ensure promotors execute advocacy process, sales campaigns, new product offering, and merchandising standards
5. Maintaining the relationship with third-party manpower agencies to ensure quality recruitments

Permanent (P)

su-tpia-1368526366.d:
Chandra Asri Group is a leading chemical and infrastructure solutions company in Indonesia with a track record of over 34 years in the petrochemical industry. The company employs over 2,000 dedicated staff, incorporates state-of-the art technologies and supporting facilities located strategically in the country’s industrial hub, Cilegon and Serang. As a Growth Partner, Chandra Asri is committed on creating high-value jobs, expanding the domestic petrochemical value chain, and serving the needs of the vibrant and growing Indonesian market. Chandra Asri is currently expanding its portfolio in the energy sector and incorporating its asset as well as operational infrastructure to supports the expansion plan of the second world-scale integrated petrochemical complex in Indonesia, CAP2.

Responsibilities

• Process inquiries of operational car to make sure fulfillment according to company requirements.
• Daily Arrangement of drivers to make sure they are done orderly and accordance with company requirements.
• Daily arrangement of voucher taxi to make sure they are fulfilled orderly and accordance with company requirements.
• Administration activities related to vehicle documents and operational cost (fuel, toll and park) to make sure they are reported on time and accordance with company regulations.
• Invoice from vendor are proceed in system accordingly to ensure proper documentation
• Sudden inquiries of VIP cars to be allocated in accordance with needs and company requirements
• Provide cash Disbursement for operational cars and messenger needs in order to be provided accordingly
• Recap driver’s overtime to ensure they are align with company regulation
• Arrange document distribution and messenger schedule to ensure well documentation

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field.
• Minimum 1-2 years of experience in administrative or general affairs functions.
• Strong organizational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple operational requests simultaneously.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and experienced in handling administrative documentation and reporting.
• Good communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with drivers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
